description: Remove every keyframe in a time range (inclusive) from an effect property and read the remaining keys back. Refuses, changing nothing, when the range holds no key.

end_seconds.description: End of the range, in seconds from the clip's start; must not be before start_seconds

property_index.description: Optional property index from get_effect_properties; required when property_name is duplicated.

start_seconds.description: Start of the range: seconds from the clip's start on the timeline (0 is the clip's first frame)

name: remove_keyframe_range

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Remove Keyframe Range
